product_constraint: 1.5x–3x same-request committed Decode with exact target state/logits/output and joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total reporting

budget.authority: Current same-ELF 40K NSys family opportunity; not measured bank-conflict cause or forecast.

mechanism: Replicate FP8 codebook across 32 lane-owned banks without full-K activation staging or persistent output grid. Each code is converted once; warp broadcast publishes copies. Keep packed inputs and original four-channel row reuse, chains, reductions and output.

resource_trade.removed: Possible serialization between distinct lookup words in one bank; the bank index is now exactly lane. Global traffic and scalar FMA work unchanged.

numerical_ledger: For every raw code c, table[c^(c>>5)][lane] is exactly fp8(c), including signed zero and signed quiet NaN.
CTA barrier completes every replica before use. All M rows reuse the same register weight.
Identical global activation/weight loads, K-lane chains, merge, live-root warp tree, final eight-warp tree, tensor scale and BF16 publication.
No persistent state, lifetime, allocation or non-MTP changes.
prior_lineage: v12 bundled a replicated table with full-K input staging, fixed 32 persistent CTAs, old epilogues and other projection changes. This candidate excludes those residency constraints and uses current v48 arithmetic. It does not claim v12 established shared-bank causality.
reference_transfer: Previously studied Marlin separates compressed feed from on-chip operand consumers. Native SM87 lane ownership removes bank aliasing while preserving scalar arithmetic; no upstream source or runtime dependency imported.
gates: build/static resource sanity; complete FP8 canonical/sidecar special-code output/guard checks
full P65 scalar prefix state/logit/cache/transaction admission
immediate P65/8K/40K d2 API; >3% slowdown stops, neutral removes, useful direction unlocks d3
expiry: Retain only as bounded next-verifier dependency after useful composed API return; otherwise remove. No production promotion.
